engine_only_lessons.scope: Four additional authored lesson inputs received public engine runs and journal replays. Rendering was not requested for these variants.

imported_manual.scope: Development manual previously filmed under the same executable. Its capture predates the November 20 campaign.

signed_matched_study.scope: One blinded model reviewer judged anonymous A/B attachment windows at normal speed. Three pairs formed a separate development set. Nine held-out pairs form the evaluation cohort. These comparisons apply only to those registered clips.
signed_matched_study.summary: One blinded model reviewer evaluated 9 playable pairs out of 9 registered evaluation pairs. It preferred the calibrated clip in 2, the default clip in 5, judged 0 tied and 2 mixed. 0 judgments were unavailable.

original_normal_speed_browser_playback.scope: Contemporaneous browser playback recorded at 1× for 114 movies including one prior manual. Frame presentation and visible impressions have separate records.

method.same_edition: An original film requires a recorded case in the frozen November 20 campaign, matching verification selector, public engine run, raw encoder receipt, complete decode and unique native movie. Historical rerenders have their own independent runs, native encoder and primary case receipts.
method.case_rows: The count of 139 new campaign engine runs covers the terminal cases. One additional strict request committed a separate engine run and two strict planner attempts stopped before an episode existed. Each terminal row identifies the input that produced its reported result. A blocked or unresolved checkpoint can occur in a rendered clip. A preceding strict input that required a compatibility request retains its own recorded failure.
method.action_ranges: Action frames are zero-based half-open [start, end). A null range is an instantaneous public-engine boundary. The engine journal and the directly visible scene describe different evidence.
method.source_fingerprint: runtime_id identifies executable source. source_manifest_sha256 identifies its registered package. The original release, frozen campaign case selector and execution receipts establish edition ownership.
